svg.title: Fantasy Builder — current Google Cloud architecture
svg.desc: Project dev-fantasybuilder in us-central1. One e2-small Compute Engine VM runs Docker Compose with Caddy, frontend, identity, auth, API, scraping, PostgreSQL, and Redis. Public ports 80 and 443 only; IAP and OS Login for SSH. Google Cloud Artifact Registry, Secret Manager, Cloud Storage backups, IAM, Workload Identity Federation, and a protected persistent disk support the host. GitHub main pushes publish images; operators activate releases separately. DNS is external. This describes configured topology, not verified live application health.

text.tspan: One host. Separate services. Controlled releases.
Configured topology · up to 4 concurrent users · 27 October 2026
e2-small · 2 GiB RAM · Debian 12 · Shielded VM · Docker Compose
PRIVATE CONTAINER NETWORK · backend ports are not published on the host
Identity DB + vault DB · separate roles
API → Auth / Scraping: service tokens · Auth / API → Identity: JWKS
OS + images + PostgreSQL + Caddy volumes · auto_delete=false · prevent_destroy
Five application images · pinned sha256 digests
CI: repository writer · VM: repository reader
Old untagged cleanup; active releases stay tagged
Reboots use the committed local snapshot
Backup object creator · no key files
CI publishes images → operator uploads secrets → operator runs fantasybuilder-deploy
EXTERNAL SERVICES · reached by egress-enabled containers
LaLiga auth / Fantasy API • FutbolFantasy / standings • SMTP email provider • Optional social login / weather
Based on Terraform + production Compose; activation / live health not verified. Google Cloud icons: cloud.google.com/icons.
